usda.name: USDA FAS PSD authenticated API
usda.limitation: Four staple commodity forms, latest two selected marketing years; estimates and forecasts, not measured stocks. Authenticated records published separately only after same-vintage concordance with USDA bulk PSD (at least 20 comparable records, all matching).

hapi.name: HDX HAPI / IPC acute food insecurity
hapi.limitation: National assessment records only; observation and projection types preserved verbatim. No country totals across overlapping assessments. Only explicitly cleared HDX resource IDs may be republished.
